purpose: Review the reading chair beside the south window and confirm access to the bookcase.
sheet_caption: The door opens towards the clear west side. The chair and lamp share the window end.
scale_basis: Dimensions in mm. Use the scale bar on the drawing.
daily_use: Enter from the hall, reach the books along the north wall and read by the window. The chair stays in the south-east corner so a second person can browse without moving it.
limitation: Fictional design review. Confirm the shelf fixing and the socket position before ordering.
next_action: The installer measures the wall and socket. The homeowner can then release the shelf order.
